data.name: Void Soul Awakening
data.detailed_description:
You play as a wandering soul discarded within an ever-shifting cosmic prison. Your existence is a blank slate until a mysterious woman grants you an immortal body and a singular, absolute command: escape the prison and defeat the entity that rules the prison, the Keeper. Armed with newfound power, you must fight through the distorted architecture of this realm, facing the monstrosities born from the prison's very walls.

As you descend deeper into the shifting layers, the world begins to reveal itself. You aren't just fighting for survival; you are beginning to learn the chilling truth behind the woman’s motives, the Keeper’s true identity, and the reality of why you exist. Every victory peels back the mystery of what this realm was truly meant to contain and why you were the one given the strength to break it.

FEATURES:

Hybrid gameplay of shooter and Hack & Slash

  • The Soul Overload Loop: Using firearms and sorceries rapidly builds up harmful energy. Once you reach a state of Overload, your long range arsenal "jams," forcing you to dive into risky melee combat to dispel the surge and restore balance to your weaponry.

  • Forward Momentum Combat: Survival in the Abyssal Cube is earned through constant engagement. You must stay in the face of the enemy to keep your energy flowing; passivity is a death sentence that leads to stalled abilities and eventual defeat.

  • Lucid Surges & Transformations: Maintaining high combat momentum triggers a Lucid Surge, a state of heightened power. This grants access to devastating Lucid Weapons powerful finishers and transformations based on your chosen Echoes that can finish off the most formidable foes.

  • Boss-Driven Progression & Echoes: Defeating over 30 hand crafted bosses, such as Wardens and Archons, rewards you with Echoes. These fragments of power grant transformative abilities and combat modifiers, which you can swap on the fly via a radial wheel to adapt to escalating threats.

  • Risk-Based Leveling: As you level up during a run, you choose between Blessings straightforward buffs like increased soul energy capacity and Curses, which provide massive, game changing power at the cost of heavy penalties that jeopardize your survival.

Adaptability:

  • 50+ Firearms Discover an arsenal ranging from precision rifles and rapid pistols to cursed launchers that reshape the battlefield. Each weapon offers unique stats and effects.

  • 30+ Sorceries Command the void with devastating abilities summon spectral claws, ignite soul storms, or warp reality itself. Every sorcery changes how you fight.

  • 20+ Echoes (Playstyles) Echoes define your core identity each one alters movement, abilities, and stats, allowing for radically different playstyles.

  • 40+ Melee Weapons Harness melee weapons forged from pure essence each one carrying unique traits, movesets, and elemental affinities that feed your Soul Energy system.

  • Adaptive Styles Manifestations of lost souls that shape your playstyle called Echoes. Each Echo grants unique abilities and passive traits, letting you tailor your combat approach from relentless melee pressure to agile evasion or ranged precision.

  • Master Adaptability Every encounter pushes you to reforge your tactics and embrace the chaos becoming the embodiment of evolution itself.

The Abyssal Cube Hierarchy

  • Four Non-Linear Sectors: The Abyssal Cube is divided into four massive sectors, each containing a collection of procedural and non-procedural dungeons. You can navigate these dungeons in a non-linear fashion as you explore the shifting architecture of the prison.

  • Sector Progression and Archons: Every sector is guarded by an Archon, the ultimate gatekeeper of the nightmare. You must defeat the Archon at the end of your current sector to unlock the path to deeper levels of the Cube.

  • 30+ Intense Boss Battles: Face a roster of over 30 hand-crafted bosses designed to test your mastery of the Soul Overload system.

  • Wardens: These encounters are found within the depths of each sector's dungeons to test your skill and reward you with tactical abilities.

  • Traversal-Based Unlocks: You can acquire Echoes and abilities that grant new movement mechanics, such as wall running and grappling, which allow you to reach previously inaccessible dungeons within each sector.

  • 80+ enemy types: Encounter diverse enemy groups and environmental hazards that evolve as the Cube reacts to your growing power. These corrupted monstrosities strike in escalating waves designed to punish hesitation.

data.short_description: Void Soul Awakening is a hyper fast action roguelite. As a wandering soul granted the power to escape a cosmic prison, you must battle through chaotic monstrosities using all kinds of weapons. Harness transformative abilities to survive the shifting gauntlet and defeat its ruler, the Keeper.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD RX 580 8 GB
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Low settings, 1080p, 30 FPS target. SSD recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6600
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: High settings, 1080p, 60 FPS target. SSD recommended.
